text.en:
BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE No. S 33

VALUERS AND ESTATE AGENTS ORDER, 2009 (S 30/09) Notification of commencement under section 1(11 In exercise of the power conferred by section l! 1), the Minister of Development, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints the 1st. day of July, 2009 as the date on which the Valuers and Estate Agents Order, 2009 shall commence. Made this 16th. day of Rejab, 1430 Hijriah corresponding to the 9th. day of July, 2009.

PEHIN ORANG KAYA HAMZAH PAHLAWAN

DATO SERI SETIA A WANG HAJI ABDULLAH BIN

BEGAWAN MUDIM DATO PADUKA HAJI ABU BAKAR Minister of Development, Brunei Darussalam. Dicetak oleh PENGIRAN HAJI ZAINAL ABIDIN BIN PENGIRAN SERI WIJAYA PENGIRAN HAJI AHMAD, Pemangku Pengarah Percetakan, di Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam. Harga B$5.00
